Name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Command Injection (CVE-2024-3400)
Synopsis: The remote host is affected by a command injection vulnerability.
Description: A command injection vulnerability in the GlobalProtect feature of PAN-OS allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges.

Name: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset DDoS (CVE-2023-44487)
Synopsis: The remote web server is affected by the HTTP/2 rapid reset vulnerability.
Description: The HTTP/2 protocol allows a denial of service because request cancellation can reset many streams quickly.
Solution: Apply vendor patches for the HTTP/2 rapid reset vulnerability.

Name: Linux Kernel netfilter Use-After-Free (CVE-2024-1086)
Synopsis: The remote Linux host kernel is affected by a local privilege escalation.
Description: A use-after-free vulnerability in the Linux kernel netfilter nf_tables component can be exploited to achieve local privilege escalation.
Solution: Update the Linux kernel to 6.1.76 / 6.6.15 or later.

Name: OpenSSH regreSSHion RCE (CVE-2024-6387)
Synopsis: The remote SSH server is affected by a race condition allowing remote code execution.
Description: A signal handler race condition in OpenSSH's server (sshd) allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.

Name: Microsoft RDP BlueKeep RCE (CVE-2019-0708)
Synopsis: The remote host is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability in Remote Desktop Services.
Description: Remote Desktop Services contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability known as BlueKeep.
Solution: Apply the May 2019 security update from Microsoft.

Name: Spring4Shell RCE (CVE-2022-22965)
Synopsis: The remote web application may be affected by Spring4Shell.
Description: A Spring MVC application running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution via data binding.
Solution: Upgrade Spring Framework to 5.3.18 / 5.2.20 or later.

Name: OpenSSL NULL Pointer Dereference (CVE-2021-3449)
Synopsis: The remote service is affected by a denial of service vulnerability.
Description: An OpenSSL TLS server may crash if sent a maliciously crafted renegotiation ClientHello.

Name: OpenSSH ssh-agent Forwarding RCE (CVE-2023-38408)
Synopsis: The remote SSH agent may allow remote code execution.
Description: The PKCS#11 feature in ssh-agent in OpenSSH has an insufficiently trustworthy search path.
